$comment: Around the Triangle. Facts only, nothing Fair Housing protects: no school ratings, no 'safe' or 'family' areas, nothing about who lives where. 'note' is for Margarita's own words (empty = not shown). 'photo' is optional (assets/img/...); without one the card is typographic. Drive times are typical, outside rush hour.

areas.name: Raleigh
areas.en: The state capital, with a walkable downtown, NC State University and Dorothea Dix Park. Homes range from historic bungalows near downtown to newer neighborhoods inside and beyond the Beltline.
areas.es: La capital del estado, con un centro caminable, NC State University y Dorothea Dix Park. Hay desde casas históricas cerca del centro hasta vecindarios nuevos dentro y fuera del Beltline.

areas.name: Durham
areas.en: Home to Duke University, the American Tobacco Campus and the Durham Bulls. Older homes near downtown sit alongside newer townhomes and communities to the south.
areas.es: Sede de Duke University, el American Tobacco Campus y los Durham Bulls. Casas antiguas cerca del centro conviven con townhomes y comunidades nuevas hacia el sur.

drive.es: Unos 30 minutos al centro de Raleigh

areas.name: Cary
areas.en: Between Raleigh and Research Triangle Park, with Downtown Cary Park and greenways throughout. Much of the housing is planned neighborhoods, many with an HOA.
areas.es: Entre Raleigh y Research Triangle Park, con Downtown Cary Park y senderos verdes por todas partes. Gran parte de las casas están en vecindarios planificados, muchos con HOA.

drive.es: Unos 20 minutos al centro de Raleigh

areas.name: Knightdale
areas.en: East of Raleigh along US-64, with Knightdale Station Park and quick access to I-540. Homes range from established ranches to new construction.
areas.es: Al este de Raleigh por la US-64, con Knightdale Station Park y acceso rápido a la I-540. Hay desde casas de un piso establecidas hasta construcción nueva.

drive.es: Unos 15 minutos al centro de Raleigh
